description: This file implements LLDP (Link Layer Discovery Protocol) functionalities for a network device, including sending and receiving LLDP packets, and printing LLDP information. It is part of a Zephyr-based network sample project related to DSA (Distributed Switch Architecture).

methods.name: dsa_lldp_send
methods.description: Constructs and sends an LLDP packet over a specified network interface.

methods.name: dsa_lldp_print_info
methods.description: Parses and logs information from a received LLDP packet.

methods.name: dsa_lldp_recv
methods.description: Receives an LLDP packet from a network interface and processes it.
